about: Ray quality guard for performance work (tools/bench/ray_bench.py eval). Each item is a conversation; checks apply to the answer of the turn they name (default: last). 'facts' are regexes that must ALL match (case-insensitive); 'any' needs at least one; 'banned' must not match. Facts come from Ray's seed documents, so a change that drops or mis-injects knowledge fails here. 'source' is a seed-document title fragment expected among the passages Ray used (retrieval recall), read from the stored explain trace.
